from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ShareRecord(BaseModel):
    """Share count information for one company from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as reported")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the share metric (e.g., 'Class A common stock', 'units of beneficial interest')")
    count: int | None = Field(description="The share count as reported in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the count if applicable (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'actual')")
    measurement_date: str | None = Field(description="The date as of which the shares are counted")
    quote: str = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt from the document confirming the count")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    share_records: list[ShareRecord]
